keyword: lowest seed to win march madness
claims: The lowest seed to win the NCAA men's basketball tournament is the 8th seed.
Villanova won the NCAA men's basketball tournament as the 8th seed in 1985.
The NCAA men's basketball tournament expanded to 64+ teams.
No team seeded lower than No. 8 has won the national title since the tournament expanded to 64+ teams.
Several 8-seeds have made the Final Four since the tournament expanded to 64+ teams.
